channel.title: ForwardWeb notes
channel.description: What I test on my own sites and projects, written up with dates.

item.title: Ontario AODA and your website: what actually applies to a small business
item.description: The AODA website rule applies at 50 or more employees. Businesses with 20 or more file a compliance report by 2026-12-31. What applies to you, and a quick self-check.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: Local SEO for a Markham or Richmond Hill business: what to fix first
item.description: Where to start with local SEO in Markham, Richmond Hill and York Region: your Google profile, categories, reviews, consistent listings, one location page and local links.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: Impressions but no clicks in Search Console: what to fix and what to wait out
item.description: Our new site had 155 impressions and 0 clicks in its first 7 days. Why impressions without clicks usually means position, not a broken page, and what to do about it.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: AI visibility checkers: what a free check can and cannot tell you
item.description: A free AI visibility check can show whether the groundwork is in place. It cannot show who an assistant actually names. What each type measures, and when to pay for more.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: Is llms.txt worth adding to your website?
item.description: Google says it does not endorse llms.txt and needs no AI-specific files. What the file is, what I put in mine on forwardweb.ca, and why I treat it as housekeeping.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: Only your homepage is indexed in Google? A 30-minute diagnostic
item.description: Google says 'crawled, currently not indexed' is common, and Mueller called a homepage-only index a general quality issue. A 30-minute check, from a week-old site.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: Google moved AI Overviews for brand searches to the right column. What to check for your business name
item.description: On 2 November 2026 Search Engine Roundtable reported AI Overviews for brand searches moving to the right column. A 10-minute check of what Google says about your name.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: How a small business gets recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews in 2026
item.description: How AI assistants pick which local businesses to name, and what I fix first: crawler access, consistent facts, direct answers, reviews, schema and measurement.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: How to check whether ChatGPT recommends your business
item.description: A twenty-minute method with no tools: ask the questions your customers ask, repeat them, log who gets named, and read what it means. By Max Ozcan.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: Is your robots.txt blocking AI crawlers? The mistake that also exposes /admin
item.description: Naming an AI bot in robots.txt gives it its own group, and it then ignores your * rules. How that quietly re-opens paths you blocked, and how to fix it.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)

item.title: How much does a small business website cost in Toronto in 2026?
item.description: Published Toronto and Canadian price bands for small business websites, care plans and AI visibility work, what drives the price, and where my own prices sit.
item.author: info@forwardweb.ca (Maksut Ozcan)
